children.text: Introduction
children.cn: 引出话题与房间概况

children.text: Good morning, everyone. Here is a photo of my bedroom.
children.cn: 大家早上好。这是一张我卧室的照片。
children.notes: Here is...: 这是……; a photo of: 一张……的照片
children.statement: 本句是文章预先给出的开头句，不计入考查词数。
children.explanation: 题目明确说明“开头已给出，不计入总词数”。

children.text: My bedroom is not big, but it is very tidy.
children.cn: 我的卧室不大，但是非常整洁。
children.notes: not big: 不大; tidy: 整洁的; but: 表示转折
children.statement: 句中 but 连接两个形容词 big 和 tidy 表转折。
children.explanation: but 表示前后语义转折，虽然不大但是很干净整齐。

children.text: Items and Positions
children.cn: 具体事物与摆放位置

children.text: A small blue bed is near the window.
children.cn: 一张蓝色的小床靠着窗户。
children.notes: near: 靠近; window: 窗户
children.explanation: 句中明确床的颜色是 blue（蓝色）。

children.text: Next to the bed, there is a brown desk and a chair.
children.cn: 在床旁边，有一张棕色的书桌和一把椅子。
children.notes: Next to: 在……旁边; there is: 有（单数/就近原则）
children.statement: there is 后面第一项是 a brown desk，所以使用 is。
children.explanation: there be 句型遵循就近原则，离 be 动词最近的 a brown desk 为单数，用 is。

children.text: My computer is on the desk.
children.cn: 我的电脑在书桌上。
children.notes: on the desk: 在书桌上
children.explanation: 介词短语 on the desk 表示在桌子上。

children.text: You can see a white bookcase on the left.
children.cn: 你可以在左边看到一个白色书架。
children.notes: bookcase: 书架; on the left: 在左边
children.explanation: 句中用 white bookcase 描述白色书架。

children.text: Many English storybooks are in it.
children.cn: 许多英语故事书在里面。
children.notes: storybooks: 故事书; in it: 在里面
children.explanation: in it 指代在书架里面，放着许多英语故事书。

children.text: A schoolbag is under the chair.
children.cn: 一个书包在椅子下面。
children.notes: under the chair: 在椅子下方
children.explanation: 介词是 under（在……下面），不是 on（在……上面）。

children.text: Feelings and Conclusion
children.cn: 个人感受与总结

children.text: I clean my bedroom every day, so it always looks nice.
children.cn: 我每天打扫我的卧室，所以它总是看起来很漂亮。
children.notes: clean: 打扫; every day: 每天; looks nice: 看起来很棒
children.statement: 连词 so 在句中引导因果关系的后半句。
children.explanation: so 意为“所以”，连接打扫的结果是看起来干净舒适。

children.text: I really like my room.
children.cn: 我真的很喜欢我的房间。
children.statement: 作者对自己的房间很不满意。
children.explanation: 句子明确表达了“I really like my room”（我很喜欢我的房间）。

children.text: Introduction
children.cn: 引出话题与房间概况

children.text: Good morning, everyone. Here is a photo of my bedroom.
children.cn: 大家早上好。这是一张我卧室的照片。
children.notes: Here is...: 这是……; a photo of: 一张……的照片
children.statement: 本句是文章预先给出的开头句，两个范文必须严格保持一致且不计入词数。
children.explanation: 按规则预给句在基础篇与进阶篇完全一致且 word_count 为 0。

children.text: Although my bedroom is not very big, it is always clean and tidy.
children.cn: 虽然我的卧室不是很大，但它总是干净整洁。
children.notes: Although: 虽然，引导让步状语从句; clean and tidy: 干净整洁
children.statement: Although 引导让步从句时，主句不能再连用 but。
children.explanation: 英语语法中 Although 和 but 不能同时出现在同一个复合句中。

children.text: Items and Positions
children.cn: 具体事物与摆放位置

children.text: As you can see, a comfortable blue bed is near the window.
children.cn: 正如你所见，一张舒适的蓝色小床靠在窗户旁。
children.notes: As you can see: 正如你所见; comfortable: 舒适的
children.statement: 短语 As you can see 常用于插入语，引导读者关注视觉细节。
children.explanation: As you can see 是地道的承接过渡短语。

children.text: Next to the bed stands a brown wooden desk with a chair.
children.cn: 在床的旁边放置着一张棕色木制书桌和一把椅子。
children.notes: stands: 位于，立着（倒装结构增加句式多样性）; wooden: 木制的
children.statement: 句子开头使用地点介词短语 Next to the bed 引导完全倒装。
children.explanation: 地点状语置于句首，谓语动词 stands 位于主语之前，形成优美的倒装句式。
children.keywords: Next to, stands, wooden desk, chair

children.text: My computer is neatly placed on the desk.
children.cn: 我的电脑整齐地摆放在书桌上。
children.notes: neatly: 整洁地; placed: 放置
children.statement: 副词 neatly 用于修饰动词 placed，体现细致描写。
children.explanation: neatly 准确刻画出物品摆放井井有条的状态。

children.text: On the left wall, there is a tall white bookcase full of interesting English storybooks.
children.cn: 在左侧墙边，有一个高高的白色书架，装满了有趣的英语故事书。
children.notes: full of: 充满，装满; interesting: 有趣的
children.statement: 形容词短语 full of... 作后置定语修饰 bookcase。
children.explanation: full of interesting English storybooks 作后置定语修饰前面的 a tall white bookcase。
children.keywords: left wall, white bookcase, full of, storybooks

children.text: Under the chair, I keep my blue schoolbag tidy every evening.
children.cn: 在椅子下面，我每天傍晚都把我的蓝色书包放得整整齐齐。
children.notes: keep sth. + adj.: 使某物保持某种状态
children.statement: keep my blue schoolbag tidy 是“keep + 宾语 + 宾补”复合结构。
children.explanation: 形容词 tidy 作宾语补足语，表示保持书包整洁。
children.keywords: under chair, keep, schoolbag tidy, evening

children.text: Feelings and Conclusion
children.cn: 个人感受与总结

children.text: Because I clean it carefully every day, it always looks nice and warm.
children.cn: 因为我每天都仔细打扫，所以它总是看起来温馨又漂亮。
children.notes: Because: 因为，引导原因状语从句; carefully: 仔细地; warm: 温馨的
children.statement: 句中 carefully 是副词，用来修饰动词 clean。
children.explanation: 副词修饰动词表示动作执行的方式。
children.keywords: Because, clean carefully, looks nice, warm

children.text: I really like my cozy bedroom and enjoy staying here.
children.cn: 我非常喜欢我温馨舒适的卧室，也很享受呆在这里的时光。
children.notes: cozy: 舒适温馨的; enjoy doing sth.: 享受做某事
children.statement: enjoy 后面跟动名词 staying 作宾语。
children.explanation: 动词 enjoy 后面习惯接动名词形式作宾语，即 enjoy doing sth.。
children.keywords: really like, cozy bedroom, enjoy staying
